run.change_description:
scheduler: replace pkg/apis/core/validation dependency with local const

pkg/scheduler only uses k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation for
NoteLengthLimit, for which a local copy remains safe even if stale.

Part of removal of k/k imports in pkg/scheduler to support move to staging.

# Conflicts:
#	pkg/scheduler/schedule_one.go

summary.intent: Drop pkg/scheduler's import of k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apis/core/validation by inlining NoteLengthLimit as a local constant, and remove the matching allow rule from pkg/scheduler/.import-restrictions, as a step toward moving the scheduler to staging.
summary.issue_fit: No issue is linked; alignment was judged against the caller-supplied review packet text and the commit message. Both promises are met: the import is gone, the local constant equals the API value (1024), and the import-restrictions rule is removed with import-boss passing.
summary.coverage: Both changed files reviewed in full. The constant's definition, the API validation site that enforces it, every pkg/scheduler importer of the validation package at base and head, and the two tests that call truncateMessage were read. Reviewer ran go build, go vet, import-boss over pkg/scheduler/..., and the two tests at the head; all passed. The working tree has one untracked file (.mcp.json) that is outside this committed range and was not reviewed. No candidate survived falsification and the change touches no security, data, migration, compatibility, or concurrency surface, so no verifier batch was required or dispatched.
check_details: Reviewer-executed at head d9cf69d74a25a209e79c7061ff86a14ab4b4b634, clean tracked tree, vendored modules, Go 1.27.0 toolchain, GOFLAGS=-mod=vendor GOPROXY=off: `go build ./pkg/scheduler/` exit 0.
Reviewer-executed at the same head: `go vet ./pkg/scheduler/` exit 0.

Reviewer-executed at the same head: `go run ./cmd/import-boss -v 1 ./pkg/scheduler/...` exit 0 with no violations (log: import-boss-head.log in the private directory). This is the focused form of hack/verify-import-boss.sh limited to the scheduler tree.

Reviewer-executed at the same head: `go test ./pkg/scheduler/ -run '^(TestScheduleOneMarksPodAsProcessedBeforePreBind|TestPreferNominatedNodeFilterCallCounts)$' -count=1`: PASS, ok k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/scheduler 3.706s. These are the only tests calling truncateMessage; neither exercises a message longer than the limit.
No caller-supplied check evidence; no CI evidence available offline.
